name: Paradisus Cancun
positioning: All-inclusive beach resort in Cancun's Hotel Zone, set across five glass-topped pyramids, that reopened in April 2026 after an extensive renovation
best_for: Families who want Family Concierge rooms and a water park
Adults who want The Reserve, with its own pool, restaurant and concierge

facts.text: Paradisus Cancun is an all-inclusive resort in Cancun's Hotel Zone, one of Mexico's most popular beach destinations.
The resort opened in 1989 as Gran Melia Cancun and welcomed Spain's royal family two years later.
Paradisus Cancun reopened in April 2026 following an extensive renovation.
Triangular atriums light an open-air design inspired by local cenotes, with live vines cloaking the hallways from the top floor down.
The guest rooms were redesigned in a palette of white, cream and warm woods, accented by woven macrame wall art.
The beds face floor-to-ceiling glass toward the balcony.
The resort has four pools and the signature YHI Spa.
An Eco Spa with Eastern architecture, bamboo and bonsai trees offers Balinese aromatic massage and traditional Thai massage.
Family Concierge rooms come with luxury amenities for kids and parents.
The resort's new spaces include a new water park.
Activities include sushi workshops, wine tastings, pool parties and yoga classes.
The resort has nine restaurants, seven bars, an artisan gelato shop and a Nespresso cafe.

highlights.text: The resort is spread across five interconnected glass-topped pyramids inspired by Mayan legend and structural geometry.
Every furnished balcony has an unobstructed view of either the Caribbean Sea or Nichupte Lagoon, regardless of room category.
YHI Spa is a full-service indoor spa with body and facial treatments made with Mexican honey, local ingredients and essential oils.
The Reserve is a setting for adults, with its own pool, restaurant, cafe and dedicated concierge service.
A sunset cruise through Nichupte Lagoon is offered exclusively to The Reserve and Family Concierge guests.

considerations.text: The Play District and the Kanna beach club are not included in the all-inclusive rate.
During the warmer months, sargassum seaweed can affect the beach; conditions are typically more favorable from mid-October to April.
WhataHotel notes it is a large resort with potential for crowding.
